raw:
@q query
  select ?v
  rank lowest ?cost
  where all
    match
      relation "be a financial leasing option for"
      role subject ?v
      role object "Dacia Jogger Extreme"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "have a cost"
      role subject ?v
      role object ?cost
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end

@a1 assumed
  relation "refer to"
  role subject "the most advantageous variant"
  role object "the financial leasing option with the lowest cost"
  polarity affirmed
  basis disambiguation

@a2 assumed
  relation "apply to"
  role subject "the down payment of 20% and the period of 60 months"
  role object "each financial leasing option"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature
